Chris tries to find out how Splodge is managing to escape from his backyard by climbing straight up a three meter brick fence. The neighbors are all happy to see the little Houdini but Splodge is dicing with death.

A four week old lamb with a broken leg has been dumped at an animal farm. Chris has decided little Leroy deserves a shot at life and takes the lamb back to the clinic to try to save his fractured leg and his life.
A tiny penguin has washed up on Bondi beach after a storm. He's malnourished and having trouble standing up. When Dr Chris discovers the shocking issue, he must make a tough decision.

Chris leads an Australian vet team overseas to help the animal victims of Fiji's devastating cyclone. Working with him is his dad, Graeme, a vet with 42 years experience. Together they stitch up a horse which has been ripped apart by a piece of flying corrugated iron roof. Lisa has to make the adjustment from her hi-tech hospital at home to treating animals in primitive conditions. Chris is also invited to an exclusive island resort to treat a cantankerous pet pig.
A hit-and-run victim collapses in a designer dress shop. Willow, a seven-year-old Husky, can only drag herself along the ground. Chris comes to the rescue, but will Willow ever be able to walk again?

Chris has a second call out. This time, it’s a Norwich terrier struggling to deliver her first litter of pups. It’s an emotional rollercoaster as Chris tries to save the puppies and keep the mother alive.

Three-month-old rescue puppy Tyson is being fostered by a family for just one week. But when foster Mum, Melissa takes the puppy to Chris for a routine check-up she is confronted with terrible news. Tyson needs major heart surgery, or he will die. Despite the expense, the family decide to adopt Tyson because they know no one else will give him a home in his condition. Will Tyson survive the open-heart surgery and have a happy future with his new family?

Chris has rushed to the Australian Reptile Park to handle an emergency. Two Tasmanian devil babies, Lara and Lily have been struck down with a mystery illness and are close to death. Can Chris save the two critically ill sisters or is the entire devil population at the park in danger of being wiped out?

Between 5 and 10 million different kinds, maybe ten quintillion individuals - there's absolutely no doubt that we're living on Planet Insect. Insects live the most extraordinary lives, many of them revealed for the first time in this one-hour program.

It looks like a cartoon, but it's a biological miracle. The axolotl can regenerate limbs, organs and even parts of its brain. From Mexico's ancient lakes to cutting-edge European labs, scientists study this strange salamander to unlock clues about healing, aging and regeneration.
Ghosts and ghouls go bump in the night, but so do many of the planet's most weird and wonderful creatures. The list of the secret creatures of the dark is endless, fascinating, and bizarre.

Much loved, clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Agile hunters and graceful in the water, and yet bloated sausages on land, seals entertain us with dramatic courtships, an endless playful sense of curiosity, and some of the cutest fluffy white babies on the planet.

Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibia's Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them to learn new defense behaviors.

In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.
The dinosaurs had a long and glorious reign, but it was not to last, and with their passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

Extreme Barcelona brings leading urban sports athletes to Parc del Fòrum for elite BMX, skateboarding, scootering and more. Expect creativity, technical progression and high-energy competition as international stars battle live on FUEL TV.

The intensity rises at Extreme Barcelona as elite BMX, skateboarding, scootering and other athletes push creativity, skill and progression to the limit. Parc del Fòrum hosts spectacular international battles, live on FUEL TV.
Is it skate or surf? Neither. Follow the story of crazy riders surfing tram tracks. Check out this new extreme sport invented in Portugal!

p.t: Right Brain Left Brain: A Think Thank Production
p.d: Bringing together snowboarding's most powerful and talented juggernauts, Right Brain Left Brain is recreating what it means to be a freestyle snowboarder and how a snowboarder uses their brain to open new amazing possibilities.

S1 E10Clark Little enjoys the waves with his friends Ted Ford Mahiko, Andre Botha, Jerret Lau and Seabass Pereze at Ke Iki beach. This people also partner with him at work and with fun on both sides of the camera.

p.t: Shorebreak: The Series - Welcome to the North Shore
p.d: S1 E1Hawaiian photographer Clark Little introduces us to his home-Oahu’s North Shore-where he captures the wonder of the waves through his lens.

S1 E4North Shore funny-man and barrel specialist Tamayo Perry takes us on a unique journey to the beautiful south pacific islands of Tahiti.  While in Tahiti, Tamayo surfs in the Von Zipper Trials of the Billabong Pro at one of the world’s heaviest breaks known as, Teahupo'o.  After exploring the natural beauty of the islands, Tamayo catches some of the biggest and most intense waves to hit Teahupo'o in years.  <br />.

S2 E5Firsthand catches up with Rochelle Ballard, runner-up champ of 2004 WCT ASP, as she heads into the fifth stop of the WCT women's tour in Perranporth, England.  Faced with bitter cold water temperatures and volatile surf conditions, Rochelle surfs her way through the first two rounds but falls short in the Quarterfinals losing to up and comer, Rebecca Woods.  With a week off before the next contest, Rochelle takes advantage of the downtime and travels to picturesque Biarritz, France, where she immerses herself in the French culture, food and of course her favorite pastime, shopping!  Firsthand picks back up with Rochelle in her home state of Kauai, Hawaii, relaxing with family and friends and taking a stroll down memory lane at her childhood surf spot, PKs.
S1 E2Hawaiian pro surfer Kala Alexander, members of Kauai's Wolfpak, and Oahu's Da Hui discuss the dangers of Pipeline and the influence of mixed martial arts.<br />.

Dustin and K.J. investigate the Philadelphia home of a late surgeon, who supposedly performed experiments on cadavers in his basement; in Middletown, Conn., renovations to the Alms House and Jail might have shaken up the orphans who once lived there.

TAPS investigates the The Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. The theater was built on the site of the former Thomas Wheeler Williams mansion where five of his children died. There are several reports of a little girl with a balloon and one employee says an unseen force caught him when he fell from a ladder. The team encounters several mysterious sounds.
A homeowner’s property backs up to land where a cursed 1740’s village once stood.
A Museum Director and a volunteer are fearful that an upcoming Victorian exhibit about the Victorian Era and Spiritualism will uncover and agitate entities from that time period.
Jason and Grant investigate poltergeist activity in a home with a young girl who seems to see the spirits.
The team investigates the historic Mishler Theater and the Altoona Railroaders Memorial Museum.
The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride.

The T.A.P.S. crew investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse located in the Long Island Sound, off the coast of New London, Connecticut. The investigation proves unusually difficult not only because of a lack of electricity in the facility, but also the harsh conditions and strong undertow which surround the lighthouse.

T.A.P.S. investigates the Eastern State Penitentiary in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania which opened in 1829 and officially closed in 1970. During the investigation, the crew uncovers a piece of video footage so baffling, they are inspired to return again (in the same episode) for a two-night stay in order to gather more evidence.
This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church.
TAPS investigates an armory in New Bedford, Mass. A camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens.

Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time.At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.The smells and voices are explained, and no evidence is found of any other paranormal activity.Jason shows Frank DeAngelis the footage from the Armory.
Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn.
TAPS goes to Albany, NY to the home of Linda Johnson. Plus, they meet a man experiencing strange events.
TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the “most haunted” places in the U.S.

Connection is a living, breathing entity, and is the cornerstone of a healthy relationship. Not only does connection bring with it the promise of exciting new opportunities, shared goals and endeavours, but it is the glue that holds couples together through the most challenging times, and allows each to feel safe in the partnership. In this episode we hear first hand how a break down in a marriage can occur and the steps that can be taken to reach reconciliation. With guest, Nick Britt
Hope Valley prepares for the opening of Goldie National Park. Elizabeth, Nathan, Allie, and Little Jack return home, but is it for just the weekend?

Liv created the Underdog Community Project to aid the overlooked unhoused community and their pets. Lacey Chabert and the team come together to celebrate and honour Liv's selfless dedication and big heart in a big way.
Tim heads back north to meet pastor, coach, and rapper, Josh Crans. on the frontline of his community, Josh has committed his life to discipleship with the youth of Coatesville PA.
Join host Seth Udinski as he explores the most pivotal moments in history and the Bible, providing insight into the events that have shaped our world.

The best-known Christian evangelist of the 20th century, Billy Graham gained world attention in 1949 with a tent revival in downtown Los Angeles that was scheduled for three weeks and lasted six. In the ensuing 55 years and more, 'Billy Graham Crusades' consistently drew audiences of thousands to arenas and stadiums throughout the world.'Classic Crusades' presents the best of the last 35 years of Billy Graham that brought the message of salvation through Jesus Christ to the world. World renowned actors, singers, athletes and ministers share the platform with Dr. Graham. Also often features the famous sounds of the Billy Graham Choir, George Beverly Shea and Cliff Barrows for an hour of blessing and inspiration to all who watch.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

The In Touch program reaches the world with the Gospel with messages that tackle such issues as parenting, finances, personal crises, emotions, and relationships. Dr. Stanley fervently believes the Bible to be the inerrant Word of God, a belief strongly reflected in his teaching. Dr Charles Stanley is the author of more than 50 books.
How does love bring healing? Today, Joyce teaches how embracing the pain of selflessness leads to growth, freedom, and transformation, allowing God to work in our lives.
Andy and Ashley plan their vow renewal, while Dani exposes Duke for drinking again; tensions build between everyone at the station but come together to rally around Andy in his time of need.
Dani reconciles with the team and Duke returns to his position at County Rescue; Dani prioritizes family time and enlists Griffin to help the team prank Scotty.

He was born in humble obscurity, yet His family had to flee to save Him from a jealous ruler. He forgave sins, healed the sick and gave hope to the downhearted and oppressed, yet He was despised and rejected by many. He spoke the truth even when it was dangerous to do so. He willingly laid down His life and then rose again, conquering the power of death! This is the dramatic retelling of the life of Jesus Christ as seen through the eyes of the last surviving apostle, John. Journey with Jesus and encounter His miracles, His astonishing teaching and His unsurpassed bravery. Discover the power and love of Jesus Christ and see why His followers risked all to carry His message to the ends of the earth. Children and adults alike will be captivated by this account of Jesus’ life, featuring vivid storytelling and high impact animation. Recommended for ages 7 and up, this powerful presentation will encourage and inspire viewers to follow in the footsteps of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

Since 1970 the Hour of Power has been reaching viewers from around the world. Originally founded by Dr Robert H Schuller, the program became the most-watched religious program in the world, reaching 17 million viewers. Now under the leadership of Bobby Schuller, Dr Schuller’s grandson. The congregation worships at Shepherd’s Grove Church in Garden Grove, CA. The program aims to provide spiritual principles and practices that can help people, as they become happy students of Jesus and live a life of meaning. To learn more about who they are in Christ through the process of formation, to belong to his family of believers and become a part of the community and to heal as they are loved and then love and help heal others through mission. Jesus Christ ushered in the Kingdom of God into our world through His death and resurrection. He invites everyone to be a part of this amazing movement by trusting and following Him. There is no fuller, richer life than the one that is lived in Christ.

Planetshakers' mission is to 'empower a generation to win a generation'. This Christian youth movement began as an annual conference in Melbourne that saw thousands of people of different ages, backgrounds and nationalities from all over the globe gather together. The movement grew and grew into an international ministry and church. Russell and Sam Evans are the senior pastors of Planetshakers City Church and Planetshakers TV showcases weekly teaching and music.

There is more to you than meets the eye. You are a spirit being. You have a soul. You live in a physical body In this encouraging message, Pastor Bayless walks through three remarkable stories from Mark chapter 5 that reveal how Jesus brings freedom to the whole person. You’ll see how Christ delivers an oppressed soul, heals a broken body, and even restores life where all hope seemed lost. These stories remind us that no situation is beyond the reach of God’s power. Discover how coming to the feet of Jesus can change everything as you listen today.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Your Pasta Sucks: A “Cookbook” by comedian Matteo Lane! Follow along as Shahir prepares eggplant parmigiana, pasta alla pesto trapenese, and risotto allo zafferano!
It's all about pork and peanuts, today's challenge is the letter \.

Chef Shahir Massoud tries recipes from the award-winning cookbook Love Japan by Aaron Israel, Sawako Okochi and Gabriella Gershensen. He makes a chicken katsu sando, blistered shishito peppers, slice-and-bake matcha cookies and more!

Chef Shahir Massoud tries recipes from Irina Georgescu's award-winning cookbook Tava. He prepares Eastern European baked goods like Transylvanian griddle breads, a rich chocolate mousse torte, an 18th-century bread pudding and more!

Long: Maddie and Kiki go head-to-head with a seafood classic! Maddie makes scallops and Parmesan risotto, while Kiki creates a plant-based version with king oyster “scallops” and bulgur risotto. Two sisters, two delicious takes.

Host Michael Bonacini explores the Venetian region's bounty from sea to land — serving soft shell crab with tangy sundried tomato aioli, radicchio risotto, pancetta-wrapped snapper with pea mash, and a giant almond crumb biscuit to finish.
Chef Michael Bonacini cooks up classic dishes like Mint Fava Bean Soup and Amaretti Cake from the well-known Lazio region of Italy.
Charming host Michael Bonacini inspires us to make simple, flavorful dishes from the rustic Italian region, Umbria.
With just a few key ingredients, each minimal dish proves that balance, technique, and a simple approach can create satisfying griddle dishes full of pure, honest flavor.
Chef Spencer Watts butters up with a menu featuring some of his favourite recipes.
Aspiring kid Chefs make hot dog pasta and test kitchen hacks, Liam whips up crunchy chicken katsu, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make scrumptious French toast casserole, and more!

Aspiring kid Chefs make raspberry lemonade and test kitchen hacks, Liam whips up popular Japanese street food dish okonomiyaki, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make vegetarian General Tao tofu!
Chef and culinary instructor Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen shows us Japanese cuisine inspired by other cultures with a pork and tofu dish, sesame chicken salad, breaded pork cutlet, and even a French crepe.

Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.
Noodles are the star ingredients when chef Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen cooks up somen noodles with dipping sauce, ramen salad, a fried noodle dish, and a one-pot delight.
Siblings are chased by a menacing shadow figure, while mournful serenades haunt a family's new home and a dark entity attacks a young boy.

After acquiring an old farm, Al Kelchener finds himself under relentless attack from the spirits of its former owners. Meanwhile, Ed White endures over two decades of torment at the hands of a powerful demon. At the same time, Kristen Whitesell faces a terrifying assault from the ghost of someone she once trusted, forcing her to confront a haunting that strikes far too close to home. These chilling encounters reveal the relentless and unpredictable nature of the supernatural.
A woman's late mother returns to make her life a living hell and the spirit of a long dead aunt is determined to keep her former home for herself.

A young woman becomes the target of a terrifying demonic possession, her life thrown into chaos by an unrelenting entity. Meanwhile, a boutique is overtaken by a mysterious spirit, spreading fear among its staff and visitors. At the same time, Kate Kirkpatrick faces a malevolent force attempting to claim her home, forcing her to confront a supernatural threat that threatens everything she holds dear. These chilling encounters showcase the unpredictable and dangerous reach of the paranormal.
Kristine McKee's new home is haunted by a poltergeist that gets physical with her son and a friend's past live comes back to haunt Danielle Low with potentially life threatening results.
Chris Houston is haunted by an evil ghost boy, a farmhouse is cursed by the presence of dark entities, and something dangerously demonic lurks in Bonnie Shukofksy's home.
Learn about Fred and Pansy’s ghostly relationships with their dead spouses.
Meet Karen and Douglas, two people who can see and talk to ghosts.
Watch a woman battle the apparition of an old woman that visits nightly.
Witness what a terrifying experience it can be to live in a haunted house.
See the disturbing and macabre ghosts of murder victims.
Watch Filipino ghosts haunt local residents and those who’ve moved abroad.
Visit a neighborhood plagued by poltergeists when a burial ground is disturbed.
Meet people who have spiritual encounters at work, like a young burlesque dancer.
Meet a couple who are driven from their home by terrifying ghosts.

When a picky 16-year-old comes to Hell’s Kitchen for her fantasy birthday bash, the chefs find themselves catering to one of their toughest critics yet...teenagers. The two teams must call on their inner-adolescent to design a teen-pleasing menu for the girl’s special day.
Chef Ramsay makes the nine remaining chefs take a blindfolded taste test. The winners get to go to a spa; the losers must clean the dorm.

The group dynamics are drastically changed when Chef Ramsey asks for a volunteer to switch sides. This week's challenge consists of creating 4 new dishes from 20 ingredients. One chef requires a medic after injuring himself during the challenge.

It's all about speed and accuracy as the teams are challenged to prepare dishes in a relay race. The winners are treated to a day of fun in the sun as they head to the beach for private surfing lessons. The losing team is forced to get down and dirty and clean the entire restaurant.

To give the remaining chefs a little added inspiration, Chef Ramsay takes them to the future location of The London West Hollywood; while in the kitchen, a chef burns his hand and the others struggle to deliver food to the diners in a timely manner.
Chef Ramsay orders the five remaining chefs to teach cooking-impaired housewives to prepare a gourmet meal. The winner receives culinary pointers from chefs Mark Peel and Ben Ford.
The final four contestants prepare lunch for surprise guests: eighty picky pregnant moms. The chef whose dish they favor wins a $1,000 shopping spree. The others must clean up.

Chef Ramsay surprises the Final 3 chefs by bringing in a few special guests to join them for a breakfast he prepared. After the guests leave, Ramsay asks the chefs to recreate the signature dish they just ate. This challenge throws a couple of the chefs off their game.

The final two chefs prepare for their ultimate challenge. They must design their restaurants as well as create a winning menu. But they won't be there to oversee the renovations- Chef Ramsay flies them back to the Borgata where they compete to wow the Hotel's CEO with their signature dish.

The two finalists, Petrozza and Christina, pick their teams for the final dinner service. Petrozza selects Ben, Bobby and Jen, while Christina goes with Corey, Louross and Matt, hoping to keep him on form with encouragement.

Sixteen new contestants step into the kitchen to prove that they are worthy of the head chef position; creating signature dishes turns into a team challenge with men versus women; one chef goes head-to-head with chef Ramsay in the elimination round.
Gordon Ramsay challenges the hopefuls to make a perfect prawn dish. Winners get a high-flying meal out, while losers are stuck on prep. Will their second night of service go smoother than the first?

Gordon Ramsay's cookery competition gets an early start as contestants serve breakfast to firefighters. The losers clean the fire engine with messy results, before knuckling down for evening service. Who will impress Chef Ramsay?

Gordon Ramsay's chefs compete for the top job at Araxi in Whistler, BC. Their first task is making sausages before tackling evening service. When one contestant gets bad news from the doctor, can he push through?
Gordon Ramsay challenges the remaining chefs to cook a meal for a Marine returning from Iraq. The winners score an aerial adventure, while one team bombs at evening service. Who's going home?
Newlyweds turn to Izzy to update their 1960s home. But after unexpectedly losing a job, they're hoping that he can stick to their strict budget.

This episode focuses on events from July to early September, 1940. The Germans tried initially to bomb British naval shipping with limited success. However, three separate attacks in August targeting RAF airfields were successful. Biggin Hill, North Weald, and Kenley were all temporarily put out of action. Then, the Germans made a mistake that ultimately lost them the war.

During the first week of September, Hitler decided to move the bombing strategy away from the airfields, to civilian London. This episode examines the spirit of the Londoners who defied Hitler, and ultimately ended the war in the last weeks of September. Having come to represent the concept of 'overwhelming victory', this saying originally came from submarines in WW2 who were able to use torpedoes to literally blow an enemy ship up and out of the water. But is this really possible? And in the Breaking Bad season finale, Walter White took down every single bad guy with a simple crank shaft, remote control and M60. Potential reality or just fiction?

Adam LOVED this one, as you can imagine. Can a whip make your enemy drop his gun? Can you wrap a whip around a log and swing across a chasm? Could Indy have outrun a rolling boulder? Could Indy had survived a Mayan temple run through the various booby traps?
The MythBusters give duct tape one more crack with their biggest build in 12 years: a medieval trebuchet held together with nothing but tape. The ultimate Duct Tape Finale.
The MythBusters tackle two tasty tales. First, can you fire prawns from an air cannon through flour, egg wash and breadcrumbs into a fireball to cook the perfect tempura on a plate?
When it comes to countdowns the Myth busters have been ramping it up for 14 years. And they’re celebrating their explosive history with two spectacular tall tale big bangs.

In their 14-year history, the Myth Busters have used over 3500 human guinea pigs and in this Volunteer Special, they’re paying homage to every single one! First, they summon up an army of 200 zombies to find out what is the ultimate weapon when the apocalypse comes.

The MythBusters have counted down to lift off and lit the fuse on approximately 960 rockets and fireworks. In this Rocket Special Adam and Jamie are tackling the all time fan favourite explosive technology in a one mega-myth in-depth episode.

In over 14 years the MythBusters have detonated somewhere in the region of 1,000 explosions. In this episode-with-a-twist the team is reversing their SOP and doing something they’ve never done before - an implosion caused by a vacuum.
In this episode that level of fan interaction has peaked in a Reddit Special. Adam and Jamie literally put the editorial of the show in the fans hands.

In this special episode, the MythBusters reveal what’s in store for their go big then go home final season, while also pulling back the curtain to showcase how this epic series got made with a behind-the-scenes exclusive.

When it comes to destroying cars, the MythBusters are experts and in this episode, they’re doing it in style! First, Adam sees if you can really lift up a car with nothing but a humble vacuum, before Jamie then tries to flatten a car using nothing but an absolutely massive load of C4.

Since 2002, Adam and Jamie have used science to separate fact from fiction in spectacular style! But, as the saying goes, all good things must come to an end and MythBusters is no exception. Luckily, the guys are going out with a bang.

For this final hour of the television icon that is MythBusters, the 5 hosts are reunited for one last hurrah! Deep within M5, Adam, Jamie, Kari, Tory and Grant join forces once more to together peel back the curtain as never before to give a suitably epic, enlightening and emotional finale to the best science show on television.

Adam and Jamie revisit their first ever duct tape episode—discussing, dissecting and delighting in the classic. Features never-before-seen footage, viewer QAndA and behind-the-scenes insights from the legends.
Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman reunite to reflect on their adventures on Duct Tape Island, using only the legendary tape to survive and provide a means of rescue. (Final)

Sink your teeth into the bloodthirsty battles between stealthy Nile crocs and heavyweight hippos along Africa’s sun-scorched rivers. See why power is temporary, peace is fragile, and survival belongs to the resilient in these aquatic arenas.
By volume, Lake Superior is the largest fresh water lake in North America. By surface area, it is the largest in the world.
Born at sea, scored by ice and the ravages of nature, the Niagara escarpment is forever a work in progress - and an unresolved geological masterpiece.
Follow the winding path across the stunning Drakensberg mountains, one of Africa's great landscapes and home to countless animals.
Voyage high into the mountain sky and discover the Cloud Mountains of South Africa, a hidden world that serves as a window to an ancient time.
The wildlife of South Africa's coastline face a gruelling challenge as they navigate the area's severe, yet beautiful, landscape.
A day in the life of a southern African mangrove forest. We follow the forest and its residents through the change from high tide to low and back to high.
Life in this swamp is prolific and water dictates the rhythm of new life. It is home to a wide variety of African wildlife.
The African Penguin is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa, and it is found nowhere else.
Surviving the Serengeti is a tale of courage and instinct, of hope and desperation-showing that during the long dry season, carnivores have little to hunt but manage to survive and raise their young.
Europe's biggest terrestrial mammal was hunted to extinction, but thanks to ambitious rewilding, the European Bison has been re-introduced.

There’s watery fun with group two as they visit group three’s flooded classroom. Ayu, Ruthie, and Kesi take a step closer to release. And the arrival of Alba - the world’s rarest orangutan - creates a sensation at Orangutan Jungle School.

Sometimes animals get a second chance. Like the majestic elk, which went extinct in Ontario thanks to habitat loss and over-aggressive hunting. But a few years ago, hundreds of elk were brought back, to re-populate the province in four different areas. Some floundered because of new, aggressive local predators. But a colony of elk in Burwash, on a former prison ground, is thriving.
The death of a wild black rhino after a fight with another dominant male, and a 14-year-old blind black rhino becomes the new ambassador for the species.

Broderick has been an exemplary single father to his 5 children since their mother Renita abandoned them. They refuse to watch their youngest brother BJ grow up motherless and want Renita to wake up!
Ashilaye says Romeo is always flirting with other women online and has photos of naked women on his phone; Tiffany thinks her husband had sex with her best friend.
Tyjuan justifies abuse over doubts; Natasha fears her rapist, not Daniel, fathered her baby.

After breaking up, Janell gave birth to their second child, but does not allow Rolando to be alone with the child because she believes that he abused their first baby. Then, Kayla is 14 years old and pregnant with Garret's child.
Eugene thinks Shannon cheated on him that he has even broken into her home to setup recording devices.

Jennifer fears that her husband Tim is addicted to teenage porn and has heard rumors of him sneaking underage girls into their house. Is Amanda’s man a child molester? How will these wives react to the lie detector test results?

Sabrionna has been waiting to return for a DNA and lie detector test to prove that Anthony's the father and she has been faithful to him! Then, Patrick returns to prove that he's not the father of Angel's baby while her man Dale fumes!

Roxanne and Andrew have 2 children together, but she is cracking from the physical abuse. Andrew says he’s worried she’s been cheating on him and doesn’t know if the children are his! Can Steve’s test results save their relationship?

When Teal'c is trapped in the Stargate network, SG-1 is given 48 hours to get him back by an impatient superior officer with his own agenda, all of which forces the team to ask an unlikely source for help completing their dangerous mission.

A truce has been declared among the Goa'uld, so that the warlords can attend a summit on the future of universe domination. Since Jackson speaks fluent Goa'uld, he is sent to the summit disguised as an aide. But his real mission is to poison the delegates! Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.
Enslaved by the Goa'uld, Dr Jackson attempts to destroy the System Lords, and SG-1 faces an attack on the Tok'ra homeworld.

As an asteroid hurtles toward Earth, SG-1 uses an abandoned Goa'uld ship as a launch pad for a mega-bomb designed to destroy the rock before impact. But when SGC loses the ship's signal, it's feared that the team is dead and that Earth is in peril.

The Goa'uld K'tano (guest star Rick Worthy), former First Prime of the late Imhotep, is now the leader of a powerful Jaffa rebellion. SG-1 visits K'tano's stronghold with the aim of securing an alliance. But O'Neill and the team soon learn that this strategic partnership may well come at a heavy price. Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

A dormant android is discovered on a barren planet and transported back to Earth for study. At the SGC, it is placed in a secure environment and activated. The android, a female robot named Reese, demonstrates a childlike curiosity for her environment world and an instant affection for Daniel. As SG-1 questions her in an attempt to find out what happened to her world, the team discovers this seemingly innocent being may hold a menacing secret.

Col. O'Neill must enlist the aid of a couple of convicted felons in a bid to save a planet from the Goa'uld. With an attack looming and the planet's automated defense systems seemingly offline, an entire world's salvation rests in the hands of SG-1 and two former NID operatives. Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.
Daniel Jackson returns from an off-world diplomatic mission, stricken with radiation poisoning and accused of sabotage by the host government.
SG-1 mounts a rescue mission to save Heimdall, an Asgard scientist, and secure an underground laboratory before they fall into the hands of Anubis.
Jonas is eager to finish what Dr. Jackson started. The Stargate malfunctions, and Carter informs O'Neill that it could destroy all life on Earth.
With the Stargate transformed into a timebomb, Earth's only hope lies in a gambit by SG-1 that could result in the loss of the portal forever.
Trapped on a Goa'uld mothership at the bottom of the ocean by Anubis, the SG1 team discover the craft is on self-destruct and that they only have 17 minutes to get out.
When O'Neill contracts a virus from a mysterious female found frozen in the ice, it becomes clear that his only hope of survival is to accept a symbiote from the To'kra.
SG-1 investigates a sleepy town on the Oregon coast whose inhabitants harbor a dark secret - the zombie-like townspeople turn out to be their worst nightmare.
Michael Shanks returns for a gripping episode which sees Colonel O'Neill tortured to death and repeatedly revived by an evil System Lord.

Even on a normal day, commercial bluefin tuna fishing comes with a whole host of challenges. But after a period of bad weather and with an upcoming buyer break, the seas are crowded with boats and competition is fierce. After a rough first half of the season catching smaller, low-quality fish, Fat Tuna will fight through it all and stop at nothing to get ahead in the competition.

In one of the toughest seasons in Wicked Tuna history when finding the fish and making a paycheck is harder than ever, can the next generation of Gloucester fishermen rise up to the challenge, battling one obstacle after another? Can these young guns of the Bluefin fishery step up their game and prove their worth by bringing home blue gold?
Hot Tuna gets help from Bad Fish to help increase profits by catching Bluefin for their family business and move out of the middle of the pack.

As the clock keeps ticking on the toughest season yet, Gloucester’s best captains must rely on their mates to help them land Bluefin in an uncertain market. But while some crews find strength in numbers, others find themselves shorthanded. And as the pressure mounts, these mates are forced to push themselves harder than ever as they fight to land blue gold and end up on top.

In a season already weighed down by less fishing days and lower prices, the fleet faces one more obstacle beyond their control: the bite slowing down. As the waters warm during summer, the Bluefin spread out, but now they’re nowhere to be found and the clock is ticking. With three days to land a paycheck, the fleet fishes from Maine all the way down to Cape Cod Bay, and the pressure to catch pushes captains to rethink their strategies.

In their 10th season as competitors, the Gloucester captains face an unprecedented challenge: making a living in a bluefin market that's struggling to rebound. The resilient fleet decides to work together OBX-style to help each other catch. The 5 original boats are joined by a familiar mix of recent captains and a tuna legend, whose skills immediately puts the entire fleet on notice.
Captain Dave Marciano defies the fleet by fishing in a secret location on his own.
Five-time champion Dave Carraro suffers from the longest cold streak of his career.

With the quota running out and the end in sight, the captains gamble on where to fish to catch quality bluefin and earn big paychecks but they can't control what bites. Every jumbo tuna they land takes a giant bite out of the quota.
A mechanical delay keeps Wicked Pissah at the dock, and the fleet tries to launch ahead.
With the quota almost caught, the fleet fights to gain ground in a fierce competition.

From limited fishing days to lower prices and with only one buyer break left, Hard Merchandise is out to prove they deserve another win after so many bad seasons, but Paul and his crew will do anything to have a shot at the title on Wicked Pissah.
Bluefin season in Gloucester is open and the fleet is ready to bounce back from last year's low prices and cash in on a brighter future.

The fleet’s livelihood is on the line as they attempt to control what bites their hook. Pinwheel fights to stay ahead after captain Tyler McLaughlin discovers a mechanical issue on the boat. Tyler and his mate Marissa work together to try and control the chaos in order to catch. Meanwhile, struggling for their first tuna of the season, Dot Com takes an unusual gamble and chases the bite, while the rest of the fleet battle to get ahead.

In a fleet filled with champions, the pressure is on for previous winners to reclaim their titles. Hard Merch is seeking redemption for coming in second last season, while Fat Tuna battles to take the top spot away from Pinwheel. Meanwhile, last season’s winner, Wicked Pissah, struggles to catch their first fish, and defend their title.
